'''Anti-Material grenades''' were a type of [[Armor-piercing grenade/Legends|armor-piercing grenades]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] and cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
